infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AURA uses the camera to show live filters, face effects and AI backgrounds in real time. Frames stay on your device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Audio is recorded only when you record a video, and it stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AURA needs access to a single photo when you pick a background from your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: AURA saves your exports to your photo library only when you ask.
